name: Zephyr 1.2 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Microwave Drawer
shortDescription: Are you ready for sleek, low-profile design, subtle, under-counter placement and ten power levels? This drawer-style microwave takes you to the next level of ease and convenience. Enjoy a clutter-free countertop and deluxe features like touch open and close, touch controls, stainless steel exterior, a sensor cook button, quick buttons, and more.

features.text: Preset Cooking Options On The Electronic LCD Touch Controls
LCD touch control features touch open/close, mute on/off, sensor cooking, sensor reheating, controls lock, defrost and more.
10 Power Levels With 1000 Watt Power Output

For precision cooking based on item size and weight allowing personal customization to any of your cooking needs, and to help prevent over- or undercooking your food. Also featuring a 1,000-watt power level for efficient cooking, reheating, and defrosting.
Living large: Expanded capacity means food can go from fridge to microwave in the same container accommodating a 9x13 baking dish with ease.
Precisely done: Sensor cooking measures vapor and humidity while the oven automatically adjusts time and power to yield good results, every time.
Drawer smoothly glides open and close at the touch of a button.
Can be installed in either standard or flush-mount installations for seamless integration into your cabinetry.
304-Grade Stainless Steel With Easy Clean Coating
Smudges? What smudges? Durable 304-grade stainless steel door finished with an anti-fingerprint coating prevents greasy fingerprints and sticky spills from building up.
